tiny_restart_gate_recommendation.scope: Exactly two updates were executed from canonical predopt in original manifest order after the independent static driver gate passed: entry 0 pTC13/BeH2, then entry 1 AE17/H2. This is a bounded diagnostic, not authorization for extended training.
tiny_restart_gate_recommendation.required_per_step_checks: At each actual ordered sample and current state, recompute task gradients and fresh/reset PCD geometry; require finite strict negative task dots before any trial. Construct each requested candidate from the widened stored base in F64, round once to F32, reread the stored candidate, and set s = stored_trial_F64 - stored_base_F64. Reject a realized no-op, nonfinite displacement, or any nonnegative task dot g_task_F64·s. For all tasks require finite strict decrease and L_trial <= L_base + c*(g_task_F64·s). Record requested/realized norms, cosine, all trial losses/dots/margins, and stop if no candidate passes by t=2^-20.
tiny_restart_gate_recommendation.implementation_note: The existing trainer's direct Armijo path uses ideal t-scaled proposal slopes and its accepted delta is derived from the pre-copy candidate tensor. Use the predeclared external realized-displacement contract for this precision-sensitive restart; do not treat the existing path's idealized margin as equivalent.
tiny_restart_gate_recommendation.stop_rule: Never force an update at the lower bound. Stop on failed per-step geometry, no-op, nonnegative realized slope, failed componentwise Armijo, or after two accepted updates.
